title: GET /health (aliases /healthz, /v1/health): the engine's and its status responder's
description: The open answer (a proxied caller without the token) is {status} alone. The full answer (a loopback caller without proxy headers, or the token) adds the configuration; the setup-mode answer says mode setup; the status responder (QSE_STATUS_PORT) answers 503 with its state and the facts under engine. engine_api is MAJOR.MINOR; a missing one means 1.0. Since 1.2 a stage process of a split model adds the optional stage block; a front stage's own small server answers status, stage, model and uptime_s only. Further fields may appear: additionalProperties is true.

status.description: the engine: ok, busy, draining (503) or failed (500, a GPU context that no longer answers); a tail stage: degraded (200) while its link is down (since 1.2); the status responder: the engine's state from the status file

engine_api.description: the engine API version, MAJOR.MINOR (server/engine_api.py VERSION); absent: 1.0

mode.description: setup in setup mode (--setup); else engine (the engine alone) or chat (the conductor on), server/mode.py

extensions.description: since 1.4 (ENG-413 WP3a, server/ext.py): the engine-ext-v1 extension this engine runs, [] on a headless engine; absent on an engine before 1.4 and on the setup-mode and status responder answers

status_port.description: the status responder's port (QSE_STATUS_PORT), null when off

weights.description: the weight profile; name is what TandemNode shows

error.description: status failed: in words; the status responder: the OpenAI error object

engine.description: the status responder: the engine's facts (state, since, reason, expected_s)

stage.description: Since engine API 1.2, optional: present only on a stage process of a split model (docs/server.md "The stage block"); a server that is not a stage has no stage key. Shape 1: every field below but steps and state is always present; a field added later is optional. None of it is measured; state holds live counters.

cut.description: hi on the front, lo on the tail

identity.description: this stage's handshake identity by content, 16 hex digits; null on the tail before its first link

options.description: the limits the stage serves with: slots, caches, graphs, kv_cache, images, prefill_chunk, max_len, carry, table, ple_layers; with caches on snapshots_gb, cache_dir (set or none), cache_dir_gb, joint_round; LFM2 MoE: slots, graphs, caches, kv_cache, prefill_chunk, verify_rows_max, attention_chunk, max_len, carry

epoch.description: 0 before the first link; +1 each link

reason.description: null while up; down: no peer yet, refused (<reason>) with auth, version, code, weights, family, layers, stage, caches or slots, timeout, closed, peer closed, stage error, ...

transport.description: tcp; null before the first link

bytes.description: tx, rx of the current link; null before the first

peer.description: the other stage of the last link; null before the first link

identity.description: equals the other stage's own identity

state.description: with caches on only: live counters, the tail's (chunks, steps, trees, rounds, round_blocks, round_max, snapshots, restore_hits, restore_misses, quiet_steps, drops, marks, rebuilds, replays, slots) or the front's (snapshots, restores, restore_misses, quiet_steps, rounds, slots: each slot's store report)
